'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**Sources claim that [[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] is interested in negotiating a [[ceasefire]], which would freeze the conflict at the current frontlines. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/putin-wants-ukraine-ceasefire-current-frontlines-sources-say-2024-05-24/ (Reuters)]
**The [[European Union]] makes a decision allowing [[Ukraine]] to use interest funds from frozen Russian bank accounts, totaling [[Euro|€]]2.5 billion ($2.7 billion) per year. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/23/new-ground-is-being-broken-eu-seizes-russian-profits-for-ukraine (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Haitian crisis (2018–present)|Haitian crisis]]
**Two [[American Christian]] [[missionaries]], one of them the daughter of a [[Missouri House of Representatives|Missouri State Representative]], and a [[Haitians|Haitian]] pastor are killed in a gang [[ambush]] in [[Port-au-Prince]], [[Haiti]]. [https://www.wsj.com/world/two-american-missionaries-killed-by-haitian-gang-ce17a19e (''The Wall Street Journal'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[2024 Cannes Film Festival]]
**''[[Norah (film)|Norah]]'' becomes the first film from [[Saudi Arabia]] to screen as part of the official calendar at the [[Cannes Film Festival]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2515551/lifestyle (Arab News)]
**''[[Black Dog (2024 film)|Black Dog]]'', a [[China|Chinese]] film directed by [[Guan Hu]], wins the ''[[Un Certain Regard]]'' prize for international films at the Cannes Film Festival. [https://www.reuters.com/lifestyle/black-dog-wins-un-certain-regard-competition-cannes-2024-05-24/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Enga landslide]]
**Four people are confirmed killed and many others are presumed dead in a landslide in [[Enga Province]], [[Papua New Guinea]]. [https://www.postcourier.com.pg/more-than-1000-people-perish-in-massive-landslide-in-enga-province/ (''Papua New Guinea Post-Courier'')] [https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/pacific/517753/hundreds-feared-dead-after-huge-landslide-in-papua-new-guinea (RNZ)] 
*Fourteen people are killed and three others are injured in a building fire in a densely populated area of [[Hanoi]], [[Vietnam]]. [https://e.vnexpress.net/news/news/many-deaths-in-hanoi-house-fire-4749902.html (''VnExpress'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/building-fire-kills-14-people-vietnam-capital-2024-05-24/ (Reuters)] 
*Dozens of people are killed across [[Mexico]] in a deadly heatwave, with temperatures as high as {{conv|45|C|F}} recorded. [https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20240524-dozens-dead-in-blistering-weeks-long-heat-wave-in-mexico (France 24)] [https://www.dw.com/en/mexico-heat-wave-kills-several-people-hotter-days-ahead/a-69167468 (DW)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Bishkek riots]]
**Hundreds of international students from [[Pakistan]] and other Asian countries leave [[Kyrgyzstan]] following attacks by [[Kyrgyz people|Kyrgyz]] nationalist mobs on student hostels in [[Bishkek]] earlier this month. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/hundreds-foreign-students-flee-kyrgyzstan-after-mob-attack-2024-05-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[Crocus City Hall attack]]
**Russia arrests more than 20 people in connection with the [[Islamic State – Khorasan Province]] attack on the [[Crocus City Hall]] concert venue in [[Krasnogorsk, Moscow Oblast|Krasnogorsk]], [[Moscow Oblast]], in March. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-spy-chief-says-ukraine-was-directly-involved-moscow-concert-hall-attack-2024-05-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[South Africa's genocide case against Israel]]
**The [[International Court of Justice]], in a 13–2 decision, orders [[Israel]] to stop their [[Rafah offensive|military offensive in Rafah]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/world-court-rule-request-halt-israels-rafah-offensive-2024-05-24/ (Reuters)]
*''[[United States v. Live Nation Entertainment]]''
**The first consumer [[class action]] lawsuit by ticket buyers is filed against [[Ticketmaster]] and [[Live Nation Entertainment]], following the lawsuit filed by the [[United States Department of Justice]]. [https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/boards-policy-regulation/live-nation-ticket-buyers-sue-wake-us-justice-department-case-2024-05-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[Uvalde school shooting]]
**Families in [[Uvalde, Texas]], U.S., file a lawsuit against [[Daniel Defense]] and [[Activision Blizzard]] for creating the [[M4 carbine|DDM4 V7]] gun and promoting the weapon through the game ''[[Call of Duty]]'', respectively. They also sue [[Meta Platforms]] for owning [[Instagram]], which was used by the gunman. [https://apnews.com/article/uvalde-shooting-elementary-anniversary-texas-a20e7fefa9d66058a8ff6611fa808df8 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 United Kingdom general election]]
**A record number of [[Conservative Party (UK)|Conservative]] [[Member of Parliament (United Kingdom)|MP]]s [[Candidates in the 2024 United Kingdom general election#MPs not standing for re-election|stand down]] ahead of the [[United Kingdom|UK]] election. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c844x1xp05xo (BBC News)] [https://news.sky.com/story/record-exodus-of-tory-mps-from-conservative-party-as-many-believe-defeat-is-inevitable-13142743 (Sky News)]
**[[Jeremy Corbyn]] is expelled from the [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]] after confirming that he will stand as an independent candidate in the election. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/politics/jeremy-corbyn-islington-general-candidate-mp-b2550779.html (''The Independent'')]
